mapper.select: SELECT pr.id, pr.content, pr.rate, pr.created_at AS publishedAt, pr.images, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.nick_name AS nickName FROM product_reviews pr LEFT JOIN users u on pr.user_id = u.id WHERE pr.goods_id=#{id} ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.cover, p.min_price, p.max_price, p.anchor, p.description, p.images, p.purpose, p.total_sales, p.stock, p.status, p.size_range, p.make_time, p.created_at,
to_json(st.styles) AS "styleList", to_json(mt.materials) AS "materialList"
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cs.product_id, ARRAY_AGG(s.name) AS styles FROM custom_pro_styles cs JOIN styles s ON cs.style_id = s.id GROUP BY cs.product_id ) st ON p.id = st.product_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cm.products_id, ARRAY_AGG(m.name) AS materials FROM custom_pro_materials cm JOIN materials m ON cm.material_id = m.id GROUP BY cm.products_id ) mt ON p.id = mt.products_id
WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.status = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normal,
SUM(CASE WHEN stock < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lowStock,
SUM(CASE WHEN total_sales > 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hot
FROM products WHERE type = 'mass'
